findings.passage: I will continue to focus on changing the laws to make it easier to vote. We must stop every attempt to lead us back to the days of paying a poll tax.
findings.note: Campaign priorities page, section 'Defend Everyone's Right to Vote'. General statement on voting access; names no ID or citizenship rule. Page is undated; carries the 2026-11-03 election date in its title.

findings.passage: This was called a Poll Tax, and Texas did not repeal it until 1966. All eligible minority voters were required to pay about $1.75 in order to vote. The poll tax law kept the poor and minority population from voting.
findings.note: Same page; she describes the poll tax her father paid to vote as a barrier to poor and minority voters. Historic voting-barrier remark, not about ID.
